note: Main-process organs load as one set through index.js (create/dispose). The renderer folder is the UI organ.

main.index.js: Wires every service together and registers the chat IPC handlers. Exports create(kernel) and the returned object's dispose().
main.agent.js: The agent loop: context building, streaming, tool calls behind approvals, compression, voice, steering.
main.tools.js: Tool registry: coding tools, app tools, browser, memory, images. Add a tool by pushing an object with name/description/parameters/risk/summary/run.
main.llm.js: OpenAI-compatible client: model listing (LM Studio, Ollama, generic), streaming with reasoning-tag filtering.
main.browser.js: The agent's browser (WebContentsView / hidden window) and its primitives.
main.voice.js: KittenTTS + Whisper sidecar bridge, custom TTS, say fallback.
main.speech-queue.js: Speak while writing: cuts the streamed reply into sentences, synthesises at most two at a time through voice.tts(), hands the audio back in reading order, and joins the pieces into one WAV.
main.goals.js: Reflection after sessions and autonomous goal work.
main.companion.js: The phone companion: an HTTPS server bound to the tailnet that serves the mobile web app and its chat API, with paired device tokens.
main.mcp.js: MCP client: remote servers over Streamable HTTP (Bearer token), their tools offered to the agent behind the approval gate.
main.approvals.js: Approval gate with modes, smart approvals and timeouts.
main.notify.js: Desktop notifications with the AppleScript fallback.
main.workspace.js: Workspace folder helpers and repo discovery.
main.hardware.js: Help me choose: reads this computer (OS, memory, free disk, GPU), finds AI servers already running on localhost, and picks a tested model from docs/recommendations.json.
main.localEngine.js: The in-app llama.cpp engine: downloads the pinned llama-server build and model, verifies their SHA-256, runs the server on 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch key while Lyra is open, and registers it as the provider Local (llama.cpp).
